Read ACO (Airspace Colour) File

Source: R/read_aco.R
read_aco.Rd

This function parses SAAM .aco files. These files link specific airblocks (often defined by Sector:Airblock composite names) to visual properties like RGB color, transparency, and display flags.

The file structure is defined as follows:

  • Extension: aco

  • Origin: SAAM

  • Separator: Whitespace

Record Structure:

  • Field 1: Version (Format version, usually 1).

  • Field 2: Airblock Name (Format: Sector:Airblock or just Airblock).

  • Field 3: Flight Level Bottom (Padded with 0, e.g., 085).

  • Field 4: Flight Level Top (Padded with 0).

  • Field 5: Nb Colours (Number of color definitions following).

  • Field 6: Colour Version.

  • Field 7: Colour Name ("?" is default).

  • Field 8: Feature Code (Bitmask for display flags, see details).

  • Field 9: Colour Flag (1=Defined here, 0=Inherited).

  • Field 10: Type (Usually "C").

  • Field 11: Transparency (0-255).

  • Field 12: Red (0-255).

  • Field 13: Green (0-255).

  • Field 14: Blue (0-255).

Usage

read_aco(aco_file)

Arguments

aco_file

Path to the .aco file.

Value

A data.table with the following columns:

  • airblock_name: Character (The raw ID from the file).

  • fl_bottom: Integer.

  • fl_top: Integer.

  • feature_code: Integer (Bitmask).

  • transparency: Integer.

  • red: Integer.

  • green: Integer.

  • blue: Integer.

  • hex: Character (Derived hex color string for convenience, e.g., "#RRGGBB").

Details

Reads a .aco file defining display attributes (colors, transparency, flags) for 3D airblocks.
